title: bella 12 Cup Programmable Coffee Maker, Reusable Dishwasher Safe Accessories, Easy LCD display, Auto Shutoff, 900 watt, Seaglass
features: Wake up to fresh coffee: Program your brew up to 24 hours ahead so it's ready when you are. Designed for busy mornings and effortless routines, this coffee maker puts convenience on your countertop.
Clear, simple display: The easy-to-read digital screen makes it effortless to program your brew, check the time, or make adjustments—even on your sleepiest mornings.
Pour mid-brew with ease: The pause and serve feature lets you grab a cup while coffee's still brewing—no mess, no wait. Perfect for busy mornings when every second counts.
Sustainable and simple: Comes with a reusable filter basket and measuring scoop, so you can skip the paper waste and enjoy a hassle-free brew every time.
